previous_assumption: QuotationOffer's startDate/endDate could stay a free, unrestricted counter-offer field even after quotation dates were locked to the Requirement at creation time
correction: That leaves two competing channels for changing a quotation's dates once locked -- the new explicit proposeAlternateDates/respondToAlternateDates request+approval flow, and a silent one via makeOffer/applyAcceptedOffer. Closed the second: makeOffer now always carries the quotation's own current start_date/end_date forward regardless of the caller's input, so alternate-dates is the only sanctioned way to change dates post-creation.
